pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who BlueWave Pool Care is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A BlueWave technician skimming and servicing a residential pool

children: BlueWave started with a simple idea: owning a pool should be all fun and no chore. No skimming after work, no guessing at chemicals, no green surprise after a week away — just clear water, always ready.

We’re a local, licensed and insured team that treats every pool like our own — the same trained techs each week, flat-rate plans you can count on, and a standing promise to make it right if a visit isn’t perfect.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: A set weekly day you can rely on, with a text when we’re on the way and another with a recap once the pool’s done.
You know what weekly service costs before we start — no surprise fees, no upsells, no haggling.
Every visit we test and balance the water, and if something’s ever off, we come back and fix it. Clear, safe water is the whole job.
